# BENEO – Together we contribute to better nutrition and health

The expectations regarding nutritional choices and functionalities of food have drastically grown
over the last decades.

BENEO is your global partner in catering to the [latest trends and developments in the food and feed
industry][124]. Together, we contribute to better nutrition and health. And with local branches all
over the world, you always have a competent expert to talk to. Just get in touch.

Consumers actively choose foods that contribute to their well-being. Even more, products that match
their individual lifestyles are on [trend][125]. As the demand for convenient and easy to prepare
food continues, the expectations on nutrition also continue to grow. To name just a few, these
include the [reduction of sugar][126] and fat without compromising on taste and texture, increased
dietary fibre intake, plus a need for [healthier weight][127] and [energy management][128].

expectations on the nutritional quality of their feed products. They expect targeted feed, aqua and
pet food that provides their animals with the right amount of nutrients.

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

# Texture that transforms every bite

## Formulate with our versatile ingredient solutions that help you exceed consumer expectations for
## amazing taste and better nutrition

Ingredion is your ideal partner in developing the future of food, empowering you to create consumer
preferred products that offer exceptional eating experiences with the on-trend benefits they desire.

### Unlock consumer-preferred sweet taste without artificial sweeteners

New PureCircle Clean Taste Solubility Solution (CTSS) is a patented technology offering improved
taste performance, cleaner labels and is 100 times more soluble than Reb M.

[Learn more][2]

[Picture 1118121461]

We can also help you accelerate your sustainability initiatives with our tailored ESG solutions
specific to food and beverage manufacturers. Ingredion's sustainable innovation and regenerative
agriculture practices deliver unmatched, [industry-leading sustainability results][3] that help

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

### Nature is our most powerful source of medicine

and demand of 21st century healthcare needs.

predictability, resulting in drug shortages that ultimately impact patient care.

## We manufacture essential medicines

Antheia’s biosynthesis platform leverages advanced manufacturing technologies to produce
biosynthetic Key Starting Materials (KSMs) and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) for
essential medicines in a more efficient, agile, and sustainable approach. Advanced biosynthesis will
transform pharmaceutical supply chains and unlock new opportunities in drug development and
discovery.

### A revolutionary alternative to legacy approaches

The USDA cites that 40% of Western drugs are derived from plants. These medicines are sourced in an
agricultural process that is typically inefficient, inflexible, and highly susceptible to climate
events, inconsistent soil health, pests, and diseases. We need a more efficient, sustainable, and
reliable approach than legacy agricultural-based sources.

### Supply Chain

Agricultural sources can have unpredictable yields. Manufacturing in contained fermentation
environments offers a more reliable, controlled, and consistent supply.

### Resource Utilization

Agricultural-based manufacturing is inefficient and expensive. Purpose-built biomanufacturing
facilities reduce the need for agricultural sourcing and the associated costs, environmental
impacts, and long timelines.

### Novel Solution

Chemical synthesis is not suitable for KSMs and APIs of greater complexity. Advanced biosynthesis –
the leading 21st century technology – enables efficient biomanufacturing of pharma ingredients of
unprecedented complexity.

* ### ARCITEKBIO
  
  Building Sustainable Sweeteners
  
  Contact us
[ Contact us ][6]

### Welcome

Xylitol is a natural sweetener which can replace sugar in a variety of consumer products such as
chewing gum and confectionary, where it helps to protect children’s teeth. EcoXyl, a highly
efficient biomanufacturing process, offers a disruptive solution into this large and evolving market

**Investors**
ARCITEKBio is a cleantech business who’s bio-manufacturing platform allows C5 sugar waste/processed
streams to be converted into xylitol: the world’s leading sugar substitute with an estimated $1.4bn
market. In 2019 we successfully won Innovate UK funding and are now moving onto our first private
equity seed round. If you are interested in cleantech, a sustainable low carbon footprint
biotechnology, synthetic biology and chemical engineering techno-economics [please feel free to
contacts us for an initial discussion.][7]
 
**Waste stream producers**
Many waste stream producers have to pay disposal costs or at best obtain modest revenues from
selling the streams as low value by-products. ARCITEKBio offer a high value chemical alternative and
are therefore seeking collaborations leading to joint ventures with waste producers who are keen to
maximise revenues and minimise their environmental footprint. We are actively seeking dialogue with
paper & pulp manufacturers, brewers, distillers and agricultural waste producers. [Please feel free
to contact us for an initial discussion.][8]

 
**Xylitol manufacturers**
We understand the supply chain, legislative and environmental pressures which current xylitol
manufacturers are experiencing from the historical chemical based processes. ARCITEKBio has a
biotechnology which is feedstock independent, requires no pre-clean up/detoxification and has
competitive yields, purity and techno-economics. [Please feel free to contact us for an initial
discussion.][9]

 
**Xylitol end-users**
We have strong supply chain network for sustainable production of high quality/grade xylitol.
However we would love to hear from xylitol end-users about their opinions/interest in xylitol and or
our biotechnological xylitol platform.  

#### Creating sweeteners from agricultural waste

A new biotech process for producing Xylitol from waste feedstocks. Like wood and straw.
[More][10]

### Uses of Xylitol

One of xylitol’s major advantages is that is has no after-taste and this is driving manufacturers to
use it in more food and bakery products as well as in the pharma industry. 
[Learn more][11]

We understand the supply chain, legislative and environmental pressures which current xylitol
manufacturers are experiencing from the historical chemical based processes. ARCITEKBio has a
biotechnology which is feedstock independent, requires no pre-clean up/detoxification and has
competitive yields, purity and techno-economics. [Please feel free to contact us for an initial
discussion.][9]

 
**Xylitol end-users**
We have strong supply chain network for sustainable production of high quality/grade xylitol.
However we would love to hear from xylitol end-users about their opinions/interest in xylitol and or
our biotechnological xylitol platform.  

#### Creating sweeteners from agricultural waste

A new biotech process for producing Xylitol from waste feedstocks. Like wood and straw.
[More][10]

### Uses of Xylitol

One of xylitol’s major advantages is that is has no after-taste and this is driving manufacturers to
use it in more food and bakery products as well as in the pharma industry.

pallet/container quote.

[learn more][68]

BulkSweetener factory.]
03

about 600× sweeter than sugar.

predictable deliveries. Book a formulation consult.

#### Xylitol E-967

sweet as sugar.

gums. Helps retain moisture and provides a smooth, pleasant mouthfeel. We supply consistent particle
size options and full documentation to streamline approvals. Request bulk sweetener pricing & lead
times.

[learn more][71]

factory.]

about 200× sweeter than sugar.

Sugar-like bulk sweetener (aspartame) ideal for dry mixes and cold-fill beverages. Commonly used in
powdered drinks, desserts, and nutrition products. We help you achieve precise flavor targets and
maintain consistent quality from pilot to full-scale production. Request bulk sweetener pricing &
lead times.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

to make their calls?

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.

  Anwar, Muhammad Fahad
  Show more
  The conventional agriculture and food supply chain (AFSC) suffers from concerns such as food
  security, food waste, operational inefficiency, instances of food fraud, and lack of traceability,
  among others. These concerns exist due to a lack of traceability, transparency, digitalization,
  and interconnectedness across AFSC. In addition, the recent COVID-19 pandemic has forced companies
  to adopt digitalization solutions to sustain their business operations. While most businesses
  reverted to existing practices once the pandemic's adversities eased, this implies that the
  adopted system does not meet the needs of AFSC companies. In response, researchers advocated for
  the use of blockchain technology (BCT) to unlock the capabilities of traceability and
  transparency, as well as to offer a secure platform for digitalization. Despite the benefits of
  BCT in improving AFSC, its usage is still in the infancy stage. Therefore, this study aims to
  increase the diffusion of BCT in the Malaysian AFSC by assessing the influence of social capital
  theory and institutional theory. Also, most previous studies have particularly focused on
  intention to adopt, and this study extends the scope by adding two preceding stages: knowledge
  seeking and evaluation of perceived innovation characteristics. The key research objectives are to
  identify the significant determinants of each BCT diffusion stage and examine the moderating role
  of social networks in trust-based relationships.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

* Sorted by category and country

* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies

Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving

living in the poorest parts of the world.

## About Niran Bio Tech

Niran Bio Tech is a global supplier of food ingredients and additives, providing functional
ingredient solutions for food and beverage manufacturers worldwide.

Since 2003, we have supported customers in more than 100 countries, delivering reliable supply,
consistent quality, and integrated sourcing solutions through our global supplier network.

Our product portfolio covers a wide range of acidulants and functional ingredients, supporting
consistent quality, flavor balance, and performance across diverse food and beverage applications,
including beverage, bakery, confectionery, dairy, and nutrition products.

With strong supply chain capabilities covering sourcing, quality control, warehousing, and delivery,
we ensure stable supply, consistent standards, and efficient service for our global partners.

# We provide pet health, safety, and behavior resources.
# You provide the love.

[dog and cat snuggling preventive vet homepage]

## Health, safety, and happiness. It’s what every dog and cat deserves.
## It’s why we’re here. We’re glad you found us.

This is your place for information focused on your pet’s health and mental well-being for every
stage of your journey together.

Our team of preventive health and critical care veterinarians, certified trainers, behavior
consultants, and extremely passionate pet lovers are doing all the leg work to provide you with
clear, concise pet care information you can trust.

This is all we focus on: education, advice, and support for you and your pet. Along with our
extensive library of articles, we offer [virtual dog training classes][28] and recommended product
solutions for your pet’s health and behavior needs.

## Sniff around and explore our pet resource library!

[ [cat sitting in the sink after using pet safer cleaning products] ][29]
[

## Cleaning Products That Are Safe for Pets

][30]

Cleaning product ingredients can be toxic to your dog or cat, like bleach, ammonia, and more! Learn
about pet-safe cleaning product alternatives.

[ [close up of foxtail grass seed awns that are harmful to dogs] ][31]
[

## How to Remove Foxtails From Your Dog & Prevent Injury

][32]

Foxtails can injure your dog and cause pain and infections. Learn how to prevent foxtail injuries
and how to remove foxtails from your dog's fur and body.

[ [black and white cat entering a litter box but not peeing] ][33]
[

## Cat Can't Pee? It's An Emergency.

][34]

Find out if your cat has a urethral obstruction. This is a severe and critical medical emergency.
Death can occur without prompt and appropriate treatment.

[ [scented candle that is dangerous for pets] ][35]
[

## Scents That Are Harmful to Pets & Ones That Are Safe

][36]

Commonly used scents can cause breathing difficulties and other illnesses in your pets. Learn about
harmful scents you may be using and safe alternatives.

[ [healthy dogs well-trimmed paw pads] ][37]
[

## How to Properly Care for Your Dog's Paw Pads

][38]

Dogs can suffer from blisters, torn, or burnt paw pads, or mats between their toes. Here are tips to
make sure your dog's paw pads stay clean and healthy!

[ [Recommended pet dental products] ][39]
[

## Vet Approved Dental Products for Pets

][40]

Dental health is important to overall health. Keep your pet's oral health in check with these
recommended products trusted by veterinarians.

[ [cat using an interactive food puzzle] ][41]
[

## Cat Interactive Food Puzzles & Why You Should Use Them

][42]

Cat food puzzles can be filled with treats, kibble, and wet food. Interactive toys have many
benefits, from burning mental energy to combatting boredom.

[ [chocolate lab mix wearing a diaper because of incontinence] ][43]
[

## Incontinence: Is Your Dog Leaking?

][44]

Incontinence can happen to any dog but 5%–20% of spayed dogs deal with urine leakage. The good news
is that there are treatments and ways to help your dog.

[ [cat hissing with their ears positioned back] ][45]
[

## Decoding Feline Fury: Understanding Cat Aggression Toward Humans

][46]

See and hear the signs of feline aggression. Cats express themselves through body postures, facial
expressions, and vocalization. Learn about them here.

[ [the 123 pattern game for dogs] ][47]
[

## Overcome Dog Leash Pulling with the 1-2-3 Pattern Game

][48]

Playing this easy pattern game teaches your dog to heel, prevents leash pulling, helps your dog
ignore distractions, and helps leash reactivity training

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### Quick Contact









### About Virchow

Virchow Group comprises of six independent active pharmaceutical ingredient (API), one
bio-pharmaceutical and two drug intermediate companies. All these companies function
independently with their own management structures.

Incorporated in 1981, the flagship company of the group, Virchow Laboratories Limited is
today the largest producer of Sulfamethoxazole in the world.  In fact, Virchow Group services
more than 80% of the worldwide Sulfamethoxazole requirement. Other group companies are
world leading manufacturers of Cephalosporin’s, Tramadol and various other
APIs and bio-pharmaceutical Finished Dosage Forms (FDF’s). Virchow also undertakes
custom synthesis and manufacture of drug intermediates and bulk chemicals.

### Our Products

##### Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients

Active pharmaceutical ingredients or APIs can be defined as the chemicals used to manufacture
pharmaceutical drugs.

##### Intermediates

Commercial terminology used for Direct Compressible (DC). It comprises a mixture of active
substances and excipients, usually in powder form

##### Finished Dosage Forms - Special

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

##### Bulk Chemicals

A group of chemicals that are made on a very large scale to satisfy global markets, The chemistry
and processes used to create organic commodity chemicals

##### Pipeline APIs

Set of drug candidates that a pharmaceutical company has under discovery or development at any given
point in time.

##### Finished Dosage Forms-Classicals

Virchows integrated product development and manufacturing model includes a range of finished oral
solid dosage forms

### Our Management

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy
Managing Director (Commercial)

Dr. N. Venkata Reddy is a medical doctor and passed his MBBS from Andhra University in 1968.  After
a few years of medical practice, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited along with Mr. Narayana
Reddy in 1983. 

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy
Managing Director (Technical)

Mr. M. Narayana Reddy is a post graduate in Organic Chemistry from Sri Venkateswara University in
1976.  After having an experience of about 7 years in R&D and production in a couple of bulk drug
units, he started Virchow Laboratories Limited in 1983. 

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala
Director

Mr. Prasanth Nandigala completed his B. Tech in Chemical Engineering from Indian Institute of
Technology, Mumbai and MS in Chemical Engineering from Iowa State University, Ames, Iowa, USA. He
later did his MBA in Finance from Indiana University, Bloomington, USA . 

Mr. Mundla Vishnu
Director

Mr. Maha Vishnu Mundla is a graduate in Chemical Engineering, and has done his Masters in Business
Administration from USA with specialization in finance and marketing. He is looking after Virchow
Group's new business development, marketing and strategy.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
